title: SS27 Girls' Wildflower
summary: Romantic summer for girls: wildflower prints, handcrafted embroidery, airy voile and linen dresses in soft pastels.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The story
sections.body: Fatamadrina's "Wildflowers Bloom" is a dreamy, romantic aesthetic with airy fabrics, delicate handcrafted embroidery and a meadow pastel palette; oversized florals and pleated dresses are on its SS27 lists <sup>[1]</sup>. Future Snoops' Lull favours elevated basics <sup>[2]</sup>. Most SS27 kidswear sources describe collections across ages and genders. The evidence below is the fair record; the shapes, products and sizes are Forecut's application of it to girlswear, roughly ages 4 to 14.

sections.heading: Colours
sections.body: Lavender, vintage pink and pastel green over sand and white.

sections.heading: Silhouettes
sections.body:
- Pleated and tiered dresses.
- Puff-sleeve blouses.
- Wide shorts and skirts.

sections.heading: Fabrics
sections.body: - Voile, lightweight linen and organic cotton <sup>[1]</sup>.

design_implications:
- Line voile where needed; no long ribbons at the neck.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
